title: Chained to Destiny
description: A dramatic fantasy scene shows a blonde woman in a white gown standing chained between a muscular blue water elemental emerging from turbulent waves on the left and a horned demonic woman with bat wings and chains on the right. A large red demonic bird flies above a stone archway with a gothic castle visible in the stormy background, all surrounded by floating red roses.
prompt: A dramatic dark fantasy scene featuring a beautiful blonde woman in a flowing white gown and crown standing chained between two powerful figures: a muscular blue water elemental rising from crashing ocean waves on the left, and a seductive demonic woman with large bat wings, horns, and metal chains on the right. A massive red demonic bird with glowing eyes flies above a crumbling stone archway. In the background stands a towering gothic castle under a stormy sky. Red roses float throughout the composition. Cinematic lighting, highly detailed, epic atmosphere.
